description: Asks how bracket, hyphen, closing-bracket, empty-class and negation-marker patterns ([[], ], [[]], [-a], [a-], [], [!], [^], [!a], []]) match the subjects [, ], [], -, a, !, ^, empty and x (Pat group p02), or whether they fail, with LIKE and with ALIKE. Each pattern is its own projection. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
